raw_record_schema.note: the split is enforced by harness/run.py:strip_nongated() and proven non-vacuous by harness/verify.py --captured (gputime_ns must differ between runs).

run_ids.reuse_policy: never reused; a defective capture is retained and a NEW id is used for any replacement, never repaired in place

recovery_model: one change per case, hard timeouts, each case its own subprocess, PROGRESS.md per milestone, append+fflush+fsync per record; if the host wedges: STOP, mark BLOCKED, no tool-based reboot.
